checks: Concurrent guards: first receipt survives lower-clock/ID arrival, retry and restart
Expected aggregate version protects notes too; immutable-ID conflict rolls back the complete batch
Legacy SQLite migration freezes prior logical winner and keeps every original row byte-for-byte
V2 backup restores exact receipts, genesis and identity into a new DB; older backup cannot roll back or branch
Legacy portable backup is accepted atomically only before authoritative history or as exact duplicates
Browser follows server sequence, shows provisional work, survives reload and retains refused payloads
Actual sync v2 bootstraps legacy history, reconnects and confirms new work through complete receipts
Two screens connecting an empty authority together receive one stable winner and one auditable refusal
Rebinding to a restored clone verifies the old prefix and refuses a divergent branch with the same workspace ID
Asset identity replacement clears the old SHA and invalidates preparation through piece revision
Logical corruption refuses reopen without deleting original SQLite rows
